newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dickson proposes to buy Barney's.
newsitem.headline: Dickson proposes to buy Barney's.

text.p: Dickson Concepts (International) Ltd said on Friday it had submitted a proposal to acquire the business and assets of U.S. luxury retailer Barney's Inc for US$240 million in cash.
The proposal, which has been submitted to Barney's, offers US$240 million in cash to existing owners of Barney's and a minority interest in the future non-U.S. store licensing income of Barney's.
"The group has sufficient cash reserves and banking facilities available to satisfy this consideration in full," Dickson chairman Dickson Poon told a news conference.
He ruled out a rights issue or any fund-raising exercises at this stage.
Poon said the proposal would only become effective if approved by the U.S. bankruptcy court and there were no assurances at this stage that it would proceed.

Barney's has been operating in bankruptcy for more than a year. The company said on January 24 that it had received an extension until May 5 from a U.S. bankruptcy court judge to file a reorganisation plan.
